description: This file defines the Twig Environment class, which manages configuration, loading, rendering, and extension management for Twig templates within the Twig templating engine.

classes.name: Environment
classes.description: Manages Twig configuration, template loading, rendering, extension handling, and cache management for Twig templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Twig Environment with a loader and configuration options.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a template with the given context and returns the generated content.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays a template with the given context.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a template and returns a TemplateWrapper instance.

methods.name: createTemplate
methods.description: Creates a template object from a string source.

methods.name: isTemplateFresh
methods.description: Checks if a template is still fresh based on its last modification time.

methods.name: addGlobal
methods.description: Adds a global variable to the environment.
